data.name: SpiritHeading
data.value: Our spirit

data.name: SpiritParagraph1
data.value: We are a volunteer cultural association based in Zaragoza with around 30 diverse members. Throughout our history countless collaborators have helped us continue growing and sharing Aragonese culture.

data.name: SpiritParagraph2
data.value: Our street shows combine theatrical staging with low-impact pyrotechnics that deliver striking visuals. Diaples, witches and beasts dance among sparks and colours while live music blends traditional Aragonese rhythms with other influences.

data.name: SpiritParagraph3
data.value: Want to learn more? Visit the “Diaples” section and discover every detail of our story.
